name: Grafana + Prometheus
summary: Grafana OSS dashboards with Prometheus and node-exporter already scraping this server, with the datasource provisioned.
notes: Grafana OSS 13.2.4 (grafana/grafana image, not Enterprise), Prometheus v3.15.1 and node-exporter v1.12.1 pinned by tag and digest. Prometheus and node-exporter listen on 127.0.0.1 only; Grafana is proxied by Caddy. Sign-up and anonymous access are off and the admin password is set with the Grafana CLI on every run. Without a domain the dashboard is served over HTTPS with a self-signed certificate for the IP address.

licence.note: Grafana OSS AGPL-3.0; Prometheus v3.15.1 Apache-2.0; node-exporter v1.12.1 Apache-2.0. Caddy (Apache-2.0) is installed on the host as the reverse proxy. The Enterprise edition is not used.
conditions: AGPL-3.0: users of the network service may request the corresponding source; Grafana is run unmodified
